text:
Maya: FinQ pilot asked for 7y retention + per-tenant immutable audit stream + legal-hold snapshot + KMS escrow. Need a suggested MVP for them by EOD Friday. Thoughts?
Cheng: We can do an append-only per-tenant stream backed by object storage + signed integrity roots. Main tradeoffs: query latency for old data and cost for long retention.
Noelle: Proposal for MVP acceptance criteria (short): 1) immutable append-only export, 2) snapshot API for legal holds, 3) verifiable integrity proof per snapshot, 4) single region, single schema, BYOK deferred.
Samir: From sales: FinQ will sign if we provide an export runbook + SLA for exports. Single-region pilot is fine. Need clarity on scope so we can commit to a date.
Eli: Compliance note: SOC2 requires chain-of-custody and auditability. HMAC or signed roots per snapshot + rotation logs will help. BYOK escrow complicates onboarding and legal review — recommend phase 2.
audit-bot: Reminder: retention-policy.md was updated at 1744320000 — make sure new SLA tables line up with the pilot ask.
Cheng: Tech blockers I see: 1) index/search for cold logs (cost vs latency), 2) legal-hold gating preventing deletes, 3) keystore escrow + access patterns. Rough effort: ~6 engineer-weeks across infra + backend for a minimal MVP.
Maya: Can we pare scope to reduce time? Suggest hot/cold lane: hot searchable 90d, cold append-only for 7y with export-only access. Snapshot API returns signed manifest + pre-signed download. Operator runbook for restores.
Cheng: Implementation sketch:
```
# generate signed merkle root for tenant snapshot
python tools/merkle_gen.py --input s3://redwood-audit/tenant-1234/2024Q1 --out root.txt 
openssl dgst -sha256 -sign /keys/priv.pem root.txt > root.sig
```
Signed root + manifest stored alongside snapshot object. Clients can verify with public key.
Noelle: MVP launch criteria (detailed): perf: export <= 1hr for 100GB; integrity: signed root + manifest; ops: runbook + ticket playbook for legal hold; customer validation: FinQ smoke export + signed acceptance.
Samir: :thumbsup: I'll tell FinQ we can pilot in a single region and aim for a live smoke in ~2 weeks if design is approved today.
Maya: Decision call: defer BYOK escrow to phase 2. MVP = immutable per-tenant stream + snapshot API + signed integrity root + 1 region + operator runbook. Cheng, confirm feasibility + timeline.
Cheng: Ack. I'll drop a tech design doc with timeline, infra cost estimate, and rollback plan by EOD.
